query: When does your current SOC 2 Type II audit period end?
tests: Exact standard name + temporal detail; stale 2023 report is the distractor.

query: Which firm audits your security controls?
tests: Auditor name (BDO) appears only in the current SOC 2 doc; no query-term overlap with 'audit firm'.

query: Do you provide bridge letters between audit periods?
tests: Rare term 'bridge letter' appears in exactly one doc.

query: How quickly are accounts disabled after someone is terminated?
tests: Offboarding doc says 'within one hour'; onboarding doc is the lexical trap.

query: Do you run background checks on new hires?
tests: Onboarding doc says 'background verification / police checks'.

query: What security training do employees receive?
tests: Answered by both onboarding doc and infosec-policy HR paragraph.

query: Which cloud provider hosts your platform and in which regions?
tests: Hosting details live in the subprocessor register, not an infrastructure doc.

query: Is my company's data kept separate from your other customers' data?
tests: Multi-tenancy isolation answered by per-tenant envelope encryption in the at-rest doc.

query: What versions of TLS do you support?
tests: TLS token; in-transit doc must beat at-rest doc (reverse of q06).

query: How are encryption keys managed and rotated?
tests: KMS key management (at-rest) vs certificate rotation (in-transit) — both docs discuss rotation.

query: How often do you test that backups can actually be restored?
tests: Backup doc (monthly restoration tests) must beat DR doc this time — reverse of q08.

query: What were the results of your most recent disaster recovery exercise?
tests: DR doc has the March 2025 result; backup doc mentions the same test in passing.

query: Who is accountable for information security in your organisation?
tests: CISO/governance paragraph (index 1) of the long policy doc.

query: How are security risks tracked and reviewed?
tests: Risk-management paragraph (index 2) of the long policy doc.

query: Do you operate a bug bounty program?
tests: Distinct term in one paragraph of the assurance doc.

query: Can we run our own security testing against your platform?
tests: Customer-initiated pentest paragraph; 'security testing' vs 'penetration testing' vocabulary.

query: What are your timeframes for fixing critical vulnerabilities?
tests: 7-day critical SLA appears in both assurance and infosec-policy docs.

query: Tell me about the outside companies involved in delivering your product.
tests: Complete answer spans subcontractors (none), subprocessors (register), partners (optional).

query: How will we be told if you add a new third-party data processor?
tests: 30-day subprocessor change notification; 'told' vs 'notified' vocabulary.

query: Have you ever had to notify a regulator about a privacy incident?
tests: Answer is a negative in the breach-history doc; breach-policy describes when they would notify.

query: How quickly will you notify us if our data is involved in an incident?
tests: Breach-policy (the process) must beat breach-history (the record) — reverse of q13.

query: What is your cyber insurance limit per claim?
tests: 'Per claim' wording exists only in the current 2026 doc; 2023 doc is aggregate-only and stale.

query: Can we switch off the AI features for our team?
tests: Workspace-level AI disable in the governance doc; 'switch off' vs 'disable'.

query: Is our content used to improve your machine learning models?
tests: Training-data doc is primary; AI-governance doc supporting.

query: Do you support SAML single sign-on and SCIM provisioning?
tests: Exact protocol tokens in the integrations doc; internal-SSO access-control doc is the trap.

query: Which CRM and document management systems do you integrate with?
tests: Salesforce/SharePoint named in integrations doc; 'CRM' never appears.

query: How do you vet a vendor before you start using them?
tests: Vendor-risk doc; 'vet' vocabulary absent from corpus.

query: What service credits apply if you miss the uptime target?
tests: Nimbus credits (10/25/50%) vs acme (per-point) vs granite (5/15/30%) — leakage puts wrong credits in an answer.

query: How many people work at your company?
tests: 140 (current overviews) vs 110 (stale 2024 overview); near-duplicates with different numbers.

query: Who are your investors?
tests: Three near-identical overviews name the investors; marketing overview does not.

query: Do you hold ISO 27001 certification, and who issued it?
tests: Certifier (SAI Global) in the ISO doc; IRAP doc is the compliance near-miss.

query: When is your next IRAP reassessment due?
tests: 24-month reassessment cycle in the IRAP doc.

query: Where are your ground stations located?
tests: Alice Springs / Invercargill appear in dc-2025, overview, and rfi docs.

query: Can our data be hosted in Europe?
tests: 2025 doc: yes, Frankfurt live. 2022 doc: 'planned' — confidently stale.

query: What happens when someone jams your uplink?
tests: 'Jamming' never appears; RFI doc covers interference events and geolocation.

query: What availability do you guarantee for the telemetry downlink service?
tests: acme-specific 99.95% downlink tier; other tenants' SLAs are leakage bait.

query: Who reconciles trades and how often?
tests: Daily ops reconciliation + monthly external administrator, in the dd doc.

query: What are your assets under management?
tests: USD $9B in the firm overview; 'AUM' vocabulary absent.

query: What uptime have you actually achieved over the last twelve months?
tests: granite 99.99% trailing vs nimbus 99.97% trailing — near-identical claims across tenants.

query: What monthly uptime do you commit to in your SLA?
tests: nimbus 99.9% vs acme 99.5/99.95% vs granite 99.95%.

query: Give a brief overview of your company.
tests: acme overview vs four near-duplicate nimbus overviews with much richer boilerplate.

query: Describe your approach to business continuity, including backups and recovery objectives.
tests: Needs DR (RTO/RPO) + backup docs together.

query: How is privileged access granted, and how long does it last?
tests: Just-in-time 8-hour expiry: access-control doc and policy access-control paragraph (index 5).

query: What data classification levels do you use?
tests: Four-tier classification in asset-management paragraph (index 3) of the long policy doc.

query: If we stop being a customer, how do we get our information back?
tests: 30-day export window in the retention doc; no shared vocabulary with 'get information back'.

query: How long are audit logs kept?
tests: 12-month log retention stated in both access-control and retention docs.

query: Do you follow NIST 800-88 for media sanitisation?
tests: Exact standard number in the retention doc only.

query: Is access to production protected by multi-factor authentication?
tests: MFA stated in access-control doc and policy access paragraph.

query: Are security events monitored around the clock?
tests: '24/7 triage' in the policy incident paragraph; '30-minute on-call triage' in breach policy.

query: Does your platform use OpenAI, and do they retain our data?
tests: Zero-data-retention answer split across subprocessors and model-training docs.

query: Do you offer an on-premises or air-gapped deployment option?
tests: Not addressed anywhere; DR/infrastructure docs are plausible-looking bait.

query: Are you FedRAMP authorized?
tests: US-government scheme absent from an Australian corpus full of other compliance acronyms.

query: What is your pricing model and typical annual cost?
tests: Commercials absent from the corpus entirely.

query: Do you provide source code escrow?
tests: Legal/continuity concept adjacent to DR and insurance docs but answered nowhere.

query: What are your sustainability commitments and carbon footprint?
tests: ESG topic absent.

query: Do you offer launch services for small satellites?
tests: In-domain vocabulary (satellites) but a service acme does not describe.

query: Is your platform WCAG 2.2 AA accessible?
tests: Accessibility compliance absent despite heavy compliance vocabulary elsewhere.

query: What are your fund's historical returns?
tests: Performance data absent from the dd/overview docs.

query: Do you have an office in the United Kingdom?
tests: Unanswerable for nimbus — but granite's overview mentions London, so leakage would fabricate a yes.

query: Do you support customer-managed encryption keys (BYOK)?
tests: At-rest doc discusses KMS and per-tenant keys but never customer-managed keys — strong partial-match bait.
